responsibility: Defines the base x86 AMX-TILE programming interface that manages tile configuration and tile memory movement. This header owns the generic tile control intrinsics such as _tile_loadconfig, _tile_storeconfig, _tile_release, tile load/store helpers, and tile zeroing, mapping them to GCC builtins or inline assembly so higher-level AMX subtype headers can build on the common tile state and tile register data movement operations.
